name: TeamSpeak
description: TeamSpeak is a proprietary voice and text chat server for online communities and gaming groups, connected to via the official TeamSpeak client.

notes.text: There is no admin username/password to log in with. Connect using the TeamSpeak client, then use the ServerAdmin privilege key saved to /root/teamspeak.creds (Client > Use Privilege Key) to claim admin rights on the server.
Default ports: 9987/udp (voice), 30033/tcp (file transfer), 10011/tcp (ServerQuery). No arm64 build is published upstream.

TeamSpeak Server is closed-source, distributed only as an official binary by TeamSpeak Systems GmbH; this script downloads it directly from teamspeak.com and accepts the license non-interactively (license_accepted=1), the same mechanism used by TeamSpeak's own official Docker image.
Without a paid license key, TeamSpeak runs free with 1 virtual server and up to 32 slots — plenty for personal/community use.
